# Ponytail on a Trail

> > Colorado hiking, national park itineraries, and outdoor lifestyle guides from the Rocky Mountains

Ponytail on a Trail is a Colorado-based outdoor adventure blog by Bradee Felton, featuring detailed hiking guides, multi-day national park itineraries, winter activities, and fitness tips for mountain enthusiasts. The site specializes in Colorado destinations including Rocky Mountain National Park, Estes Park, Aspen, Boulder, and the Indian Peaks Wilderness.

## Key Topics

- Colorado hiking trails
- Rocky Mountain National Park
- Winter activities and skiing
- National park itineraries
- Altitude hiking tips
- Indian Peaks Wilderness
- Estes Park
- Trail recommendations via AllTrails
- Yurt camping
- Mountain living lifestyle
- Winter hiking gear
- Aspen and Breckenridge guides
- Fitness and outdoor training
- 3-day travel itineraries
- Denver and Boulder area trails

## National Park Guides & Multi-Day Itineraries

- [4-Day Guide to Rocky Mountain National Park](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/31/post-4-day-guide-to-rocky-mountain-national-park): 4-day Rocky Mountain NP itinerary with Estes Park lodging and dining
- [Grand Tetons 3-Day Itinerary](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/a-3-day-guide-to-grand-teton-national-park): 3-day Grand Teton itinerary with Delta Lake and Jenny Lake hikes
- [3-Day Guide to West Glacier National Park](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/03/11/3-day-guide-to-west-glacier-national-park): West Glacier 3-day guide covering Going-To-The-Sun Road and Lake McDonald
- [Best Hikes in Yosemite](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/best-hikes-in-yosemite): Top Yosemite trails including Glacier Point and Mirror Lake

## Colorado Hiking Guides

- [10 Colorado Hikes for Beginners](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/10-colorado-hikes-for-beginners): Beginner-friendly Colorado trails including Gem Lake and Berthoud Pass
- [Best Colorado Hiking Areas [Part 1]](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/best-colorado-hiking-areas-part-1): Colorado hiking areas overview featuring Indian Peaks Wilderness
- [Guide to Golden, Colorado](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/guide-to-golden-colorado): Travel guide to Golden, CO with hiking, breweries, and outdoor activities

## Winter Adventures & Ski Town Guides

- [Winter Adventures in Aspen: Your Perfect Itinerary](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2025/01/14/winter-adventures-in-aspen-your-perfect-itinerary): Aspen winter itinerary with skiing, hot springs, and luxury lodging
- [Exploring Breckenridge: 3-Day Winter Itinerary for Skiing and More](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2025/02/03/exploring-breckenridge-3-day-winter-itinerary-for-skiing-and-more): 3-day Breckenridge winter itinerary with skiing and mountain activities
- [What To Do in Vail](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/a-weekend-in-vail-co): Weekend guide to Vail featuring Grand Hyatt and mountain activities
- [Colorado Winter Bucket List](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/colorado-winter-bucket-list): Colorado winter activities including ice caves, yurt camping, and skating
- [5 Outdoor Winter Activities](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/top-5-winter-activities-for-the-non-skier): Non-skiing winter activities: snowshoeing, yurt camping, cross-country

## Hiking Gear & Winter Essentials

- [Winter Hiking Outfit Essentials](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/winter-hiking-outfit-essentials): Winter hiking gear guide featuring layering systems for Colorado trails
- [Cute Women's Hiking Apparel](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/cute-women-s-hiking-apparel): Women's hiking apparel recommendations featuring Vuori athletic wear

## Fitness & Outdoor Training

- [How to Transform Your Body](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/fitness-nutrition-tips-to-crush-your-outdoor-goals): Personal fitness transformation story and outdoor training tips
- [A Beginners Guide to Macros](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/29/a-beginners-guide-to-macros): Beginner nutrition guide to macronutrients and metabolism basics
- [Fitness Tips for Getting Out of a Rut](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/30/fitness-tips-for-getting-out-of-a-rut): Fitness motivation tips for breaking through workout plateaus
- [Why you should ditch the scale](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/31/why-you-should-ditch-the-scale): Holistic health approach focusing on non-scale victories and wellness

## Mountain Living & Lifestyle

- [What to Know Before Moving to the Mountains](https://ponytailonatrail.com/2024/01/31/what-to-know-before-moving-to-the-mountains): Guide to mountain living covering altitude, winter weather, and wildlife
